up: Find all distinct compounds associated with document CHEMBL3639027. Return their ChEMBL IDs and canonical SMILES. Join the docs table (filtering by chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3639027') with compound_records on doc_id. Then join molecule_dictionary and compound_structures on molregno. Return molecule_dictionary.chembl_id and compound_structures.canonical_smiles. Do not apply any row limits.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON cr.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3639027'
